# GrassRoots Crypto

> Crypto and AI education, consulting, and custom solutions delivered by Chris GRC, a sole-trader based in Adelaide, South Australia. 21+ years in IT, 7+ years in crypto, 3+ years building with AI. Bitcoin payments accepted. Educational content only — not financial advice.

## Services

- [Crypto Education](https://grassrootscrypto.io/#services): Bitcoin and crypto fundamentals, wallet setup, self-custody, hardware wallet security, DeFi and SMSF guidance.
- [AI Education](https://grassrootscrypto.io/#services): What AI is and how LLMs work. Hands-on with ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok. Projects, prompts, and system instructions. From beginner to confident user.
- [AI in Your Workflow](https://grassrootscrypto.io/#services): Practical AI for existing tools. Connectors, extensions, integrations. Draft emails, research, summarise, automate repetitive tasks.
- [Custom Consulting](https://grassrootscrypto.io/#services): Tailored 1:1 sessions. Crypto + AI strategy. Data migration planning. Ongoing support packages.
- [AI-Powered Development](https://grassrootscrypto.io/#services): Custom apps and tools built with AI-assisted code. Data migrations and system integrations. Rapid prototyping to working product.
- [Hosted Custom Builds](https://grassrootscrypto.io/#services): Custom apps and tools hosted for you. Bitcoin and crypto node hosting. AI agents and automation bots. Fully managed.
- [Pay with Bitcoin](https://grassrootscrypto.io/pay.html): Accept Bitcoin payments via self-hosted BTCPay Server.
